workflows.name: Pre-release quality gate
workflows.description: Before shipping a build: test the API, check performance, analyse results, then get a go/no-go call.

steps.prompt:
We are about to release: {{input}}

Design and describe a focused API test plan for the endpoints most at risk (contract, auth, error handling, rate limits, edge cases). List the concrete test cases and what a failure would mean.

Based on this risk analysis, write a go/no-go release recommendation: blocking issues, acceptable risks, a rollback plan, and a launch-day checklist.

workflows.name: Customer feedback → next sprint
workflows.description: Turn raw user feedback into prioritised work, an experiment plan and a resourcing view.

steps.prompt:
Synthesize the following raw customer feedback (reviews, support tickets, comments) into themes. For each theme give frequency, severity, representative quotes and the underlying user need.

{{input}}

From these feedback themes, build a prioritised backlog for a 6-day sprint. Score by impact vs effort, state what is explicitly cut, and name the one outcome the sprint must deliver.

{{prev}}

For the top 3 items in this backlog, design an experiment each: hypothesis, success metric, sample/duration and a kill criterion.

workflows.name: Feature launch kit
workflows.description: Compliance check, store listing copy, launch article and growth plan for a new feature.

steps.prompt:
We are launching this feature: {{input}}

List the legal and compliance considerations (privacy/data, consent, app store policy, advertising claims, accessibility, regional rules) and the exact wording or changes required before launch.

Create a 2-week launch growth plan: channels, one viral loop idea, a referral or in-app prompt, metrics to track daily and the decision rule for doubling down. Use this launch article as the core message.
